notes.title: Perk Bar Disaster
notes.content: We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the perk bar not scaling properly on high-end screens. We have resolved the issue, and the perk bar can now also be closed with the escape button.

notes.title: March 8 Update.
notes.content: We've made a small adjustment to the resolution that will impact anyone installing the game from this point forward. Some players were experiencing the game in an suboptimal format. We've implemented a quick fix and are currently working on a more permanent solution for the issue.

notes.title: Feb. 16 Update
notes.content:
Enhanced Speed Control: We've replaced the speed altering buttons with a slider, providing you with more precise control over your movements. Now, you can fine-tune your speed to match your skill level and gameplay preferences effortlessly.

Bug Fix: We've addressed a critical issue that was causing a softlock in Level 16. You can now progress through the level smoothly without encountering any unexpected interruptions.

notes.title: Feb 15 update.
notes.content:
Addressed a soft lock problem occurring post-level victory, where no further actions would ensue. Note: Potential remnants of this issue may persist in minor instances.

Resolved a glitch related to the flame effect, where fire streaks erroneously appeared between units despite no actual activity taking place.

notes.title: Feb 9th Update.
notes.content:
We're thrilled to introduce the Simulation Room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826788/ee75a02aa0a98b9b9908f21d45a7edcd8bc110a2.png[/img]

What is it?
The Simulation Room is your virtual playground for testing strategies. Spawn any enemy unit, build towers, and refine your tactics without consequences.

Simply navigate to the Simulation Room from the new button on the War Room table!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826788/d0720918cd8ca3d70f9f322b58dc678e4d3e5377.png[/img]


Secondly, an essential addition is the inclusion of a proper ending video/scene. A short few sentences to cap off the "storyline".


Stay tuned for more updates as we expand this exciting feature based on your feedback.

notes.title: Small dificulty update.
notes.content: Small difficulty update to make Easy and Medium modes into slightly more challenging even for new players.

notes.title: Updated Titles.
notes.content: Now, the explanations for towers' range, damage, and descriptions have been updated to be more accurate.

notes.title: Level waves complete
notes.content: Finished level waves for medium and easy mode for rest of the levels.

notes.title: Wave balancing.
notes.content: Levels 8 and 9 waves updated for easy and Medium modes.

notes.title: Doubling up of towers fixed.
notes.content: A minor issue concerning the duplication of premade towers has been successfully addressed

notes.title: Level Waves
notes.content: Levels 5 - 7 waves updated for easy and Medium modes.

notes.title: Hotkeys for activating powers.
notes.content: Now, you can conveniently use powers by pressing the corresponding numbers 1 through 6.

notes.title: Difficulty Modes and Time Slowdown for Targeting
notes.content:
Easy Mode:

Designed for regular players.
Tailored for those who prefer a relaxed gaming experience.


Medium Mode:

Offers a challenging gameplay experience.
Perfect for players seeking a balanced level of difficulty.


Hard Mode:

Intended to provide an intense challenge.
Expect a formidable test, especially in the initial levels.


Time Slowdown for Targeting:

To enhance your control and accuracy in using powers, we've introduced a slowdown toggle for targeting. This feature allows you to better execute your moves with precision. Enjoy the improved gaming experience!

notes.title: Targeting, and info!
notes.content:
Precision in targeting with powers has been enhanced, providing a more accurate feeling.

The bottom-right widget, which displays information about units coming in the next wave, has undergone improvements for increased accuracy. Now, you can rely on this feature for better strategic planning.

notes.title: Pre full relesetest.
notes.content:
Game Update Highlights:

Primary Towers:

Now featuring 9 primary towers.
Each primary tower can be upgraded to unlock 8 new advanced and unique towers or addon mini towers.

Addon Mini Towers:

Introducing 9 addon mini towers.
Certain primary towers can build up to these mini towers for additional strategic options.
Special Unlockable Towers:

Discover 3 special unlockable towers as you progress through the game.
Special Level Towers:

Encounter 3 special level towers that can only be constructed in specific game levels.

notes.title: Small update - Jan 27/24
notes.content:
Tweaked the way air support locks onto targets, making it way less picky and more user-friendly.

Gave the first few levels a facelift, so now the difficulty eases in for newcomers, letting them get the hang of things without feeling overwhelmed.

Beefed up the V12 unit by slapping on three extra rockets – because let's be real, one just wasn't cutting it.

Spruced up some textures on our soldier buddies; they were looking a bit meh, but now they're rocking a more polished and snazzy appearance.
